_comment: Role-to-permission map (core-007 FR-001). One role per persona that has a login: P1, P2, P3 and P4 in Briefing, CA and BM in Forecast. Role names match the Keycloak realm roles. `states` are the review states of a brief the role may list and open (brief-005 two-step sign-off); `evaluation` opens the Evaluation page for a Briefing role; the Forecast roles are as before v2 and keep the page (rbac.can_evaluate). Forecast roles: Alvin and Sienna confirm.

test_role.name: tester
test_role.label: Test view
test_role._comment: One test login (uat-tester) that is not a persona. It switches between the analyst view (P1, CA), the Insights Manager view (P2), the leadership view (P3, BM) and the Marketer view (P4), and then has exactly that role's rights. P2 and P4 exist in the Briefing lane only, so the Forecast lane is absent in those two views. It always opens the Evaluation page. Its UAT events and feedback carry test: true.
